parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, no documented police targeting, no facility or custody rule reaching visitors, and a documented embedded third-gender tradition (Pinapinaaine/Binabinaaine) that a gender-diverse presentation may be read against — the rule-13 pattern that ranks above jurisdictions with formal neutrality but no documented acceptance. The sodomy sections are a dead letter (no prosecutions reported) and, under rule 2, must not dominate where society reads gender diversity through a familiar cultural role. No documented working visitor-facing remedy, no current social-climate data since 2015, and no sourcing at all on borders, documents, facilities, custody or care — open questions that keep it a step below the acceptance-with-protections tier rather than at it. Mildly positive institutional signals: the pro-SOGI UN vote and consideration of gender-identity anti-discrimination law. Nothing documents hostility.
